wiki.title: Sheila Lieder
wiki.extract: Sheila Lieder is an American politician who has served as a member of the Colorado House of Representatives since January 9, 2023. She represents Colorado's 28th House district. Before her election to the House, she worked on the Joe Biden 2020 presidential campaign.
